title: Economy health for DMs
summary: Review Reports has a new DM-only Economy health panel: where the party's money comes from and where it goes, session by session or week by week, worked out from the ledger you already keep.
items: Money in (encounter loot, sales, income, quest rewards, loans, DM grants) and money out (purchases, upkeep and wages, services, travel, repayments, DM deductions) for each session or in-game week.
Money moved between party members and party funds is shown separately and is not counted as in or out; anything that can't be classified is listed, never hidden.
Party net worth (coins and items, unidentified items at the value players are told) with a small chart across sessions.
An advisory wealth-by-level note compares the party with the SRD starting gold by level, or with your own target.
Nothing is stored and nothing changes. In shared campaigns it covers the history you have loaded and offers Load for earlier sessions. Players never see it.
